provenance.subjectDisclosure: A scanned marble sculpture and original bass composition, not GUOER's likeness or a photograph of the owner.
provenance.rights: Marble bust mesh and source textures are CC0 by Rico Cilliers / Poly Haven. Instrument geometry and composition are original. No reference-site imagery.
provenance.method: Orthographic triangle rasterization of the scan with interpolated UV material textures and tangent-space normal detail, plus analytic instrument geometry, resolved through a nearest-surface z-buffer. All outputs share the same orthographic projection and alpha coverage.

coordinateSystem.framing: Identical scan, eye line, scale and crop in both modes. Bass is additional geometry; no invented human hands or body.

front.subject: CC0 scanned marble bust by Rico Cilliers / Poly Haven

preview.purpose: Separately studio-lit static fallback, with transparent background; same geometry and framing as maps.

diffuse.provenance: Unlit linear material albedo encoded as sRGB; A is geometric silhouette coverage.

alpha.provenance: Antialiased geometric z-buffer coverage; 0 background, 1 surface.

depth.provenance: Camera-space visible-surface z; 0 farther, 1 nearer. Global range [-1.65, 1.65] scene units.

normal.provenance: Camera/tangent-aligned surface normal encoded n*0.5+0.5. +X right, +Y up, +Z toward camera; green is OpenGL orientation.

roughness.provenance: Scan roughness texture plus original instrument material roughness; white rough, black smooth.

shadow.provenance: Visible-depth horizon AO multiplied by geometric diffuse light visibility; white unoccluded, dark shaded.

bass.subject: CC0 scanned marble bust by Rico Cilliers / Poly Haven, composed with an original four-string electric bass; no fabricated hands

instructions: Supply an authorized front portrait and a bass-holding portrait of the same subject; keep head size, eye line, crop and image dimensions aligned.
Replace all six PNG maps plus preview.png in both front/ and bass/. Use the channel and color-space conventions recorded above; do not substitute a photo for the linear data maps.

Use cutout coverage in alpha and diffuse A. Encode depth with a shared near/far convention and OpenGL (+Y) normals. Set neutral outside pixels to depth 0, normal (128,128,255), roughness 255, shadow 255.

Record the source authorization, processing tool/version and actual generation provenance for each map. Depth estimated from photographs must be disclosed as estimated, rather than geometric ground truth.
Update width, height, alt, preview and map URLs in portraitAssets.ts; set isDemo false only for verified owner-supplied portraits and replace the demonstration disclosure in the DOM.
Run the asset Vitest file, generator --validate (for the PNG contract), frontend build and desktop/mobile fallback checks before publishing.
